regimeSub: NY Fed's Williams signals one more hike by year-end as 10Y blows through 5.2% with growth stuck at 1.5%.
themes: Williams today signals one more rate hike appropriate by Dec → 2Y spikes 11bps to 4.92% from 4.81% yesterday, 10Y punches to 5.24% (+7bps DoD) as curve steepens to -32bps pricing extended restrictive stance against 1.5% GDP

Brent drops $3.14 to $96.50 (-3.2% DoD) as Saudi disruption fears ease post-Hormuz reopening → WTI falls to $89.72 but energy pass-through keeps Aug CPI at 3.7% YoY (+20bps MoM), core PCE at 3.3% still 130bps above Fed target

BOK rate differential widens to 100bp after Fed's Sept 16 hike per Korea JoongAng → USDKRW eases to 1354 (-0.2% DoD) as HBM/AI capex continues supporting won despite BoK Rhee facing Oct decision pressure with inflation spillover risks

SPX slides 0.2% to 7670 as bond selloff resumes on Williams hawkish signal → VIX flat at 16.04 showing muted equity vol despite 10Y at cycle highs, gold at $4206 (+1.0% DoD) catches stagflation hedge bid as real rates grind higher

signalNotes.name: US Real Rate
signalNotes.note: 10Y nominal at 5.24% less 3.7% CPI = ~1.5% real rate, highest since 2023 as Williams signals more tightening ahead

signalNotes.name: 2s10s Curve
signalNotes.note: Curve at -32bps (4.92% 2Y vs 5.24% 10Y), steepened 4bps as long-end sells off on fiscal/inflation fears

signalNotes.name: HY Credit Spread
signalNotes.note: Spreads contained despite 10Y surge; credit complacent with VIX at 16 masking stagflation risk

signalNotes.name: VIX
signalNotes.note: VIX flat at 16.04 vs 16.07 yesterday; equity vol muted despite 10Y breaking 5.2%, complacency persists

signalNotes.name: Brent Crude
signalNotes.note: Brent drops to $96.50 (-3.2% DoD) as Hormuz reopening eases supply fears; still elevated vs pre-Iran conflict

signalNotes.name: Gold
signalNotes.note: Gold +1.0% to $4206 as stagflation hedge bid returns; real rate rise offset by inflation stickiness fears

signalNotes.name: USD / KRW
signalNotes.note: USDKRW at 1354 (-0.2% DoD), won resilient on HBM chip flows despite 100bp Fed-BOK gap pressure

signalNotes.name: Semiconductor SOX
signalNotes.note: TSMC capex guidance bullish per Sept 25; SK Hynix/Samsung HBM boom supports KOSPI at 6858 despite rate fears

headline: NY Fed's Williams explicitly flags one more 2026 hike as 10Y yields breach 5.2%, trapping SPX in stagflation grind with 3.7% CPI and 1.5% GDP.
